description: BigQuery's _validate_compression_support runs even for --phases power with no load, so power-only runs against existing datasets fail on the shared zstd cache. The 2026-09-25 approx survey was blocked on BigQuery for this reason (datasets tpch_sf01/sf1/sf10 exist but hold 0 rows). Skip the compression gate when the load phase is not selected, or document the gzip-reload path. Separately, CPC/REQ/lgk/k100/lgmm sketch ops have no Snowflake or Databricks platform_overrides and fail on base BLOB DDL; extend overrides or document the gap.
